engine: custom Python forward-chaining and filtering pipeline
swrl_compliance_note: A and B are Horn-style graph rules. C and D use keyword tests, closed-world checks, filtering, warning creation, or ordering and are therefore application rules rather than OWL/SWRL entailments.

rules.name: ingredient meridian organ disease candidate
rules.note: The released relation schema defines correspondsToOrgan from MeridianChannel to InternalOrgan. The legacy rule used FoodIngredient as its subject and could not fire. The corrected rule was rerun against the frozen graph; its outputs remain traditional-theory candidates rather than diagnostic or clinical facts.

rules.name: recipe historical-use candidate propagation
rules.note: The corrected rerun records candidateTreats with rule-level provenance. Outputs remain traditional-theory candidates rather than diagnostic or clinical facts.

rules.name: recipe ingredient reverse candidate propagation
rules.note: The corrected rerun records candidateTreats with rule-level provenance. Outputs remain traditional-theory candidates rather than diagnostic or clinical facts.

rules.name: nature treatment review flag
rules.condition: An ingredient with a hot or warm nature treats a disease string containing a hot-pattern keyword, or a cold or cool ingredient treats a disease string containing a cold-pattern keyword.

rules.name: meridian disease lexical mismatch flag
rules.condition: The organ keywords derived from an ingredient's meridian strings and a disease string have no overlap.

rules.name: treatment taboo lexical identity flag
rules.condition: The lexical object of treats equals the lexical object of contraindicates for the same ingredient.
rules.note: The formal range of contraindicates is DietaryTaboo, whereas the range of treats is DiseaseSymptom. The current check is lexical and should not be presented as an OWL contradiction.

rules.name: general user source-text filter
rules.condition: role is general user and either endpoint is AncientText
rules.action: remove triple from the general-user view

rules.name: general user single-source filter
rules.condition: role is general user and authority equals single
rules.action: remove triple from the general-user view

rules.name: researcher retain-all policy
rules.action: retain all triples without rule-based removal

rules.name: TCM-professional heritage source-ordering policy
rules.condition: role uses the legacy internal identifier clinician and relation uses the legacy technical predicate treats
rules.action: order source-supported historical-use records before less-supported records

release_note: Operational outputs are candidates, review flags or presentation policies; they are not modern clinical facts.
